Hannah Shaw is an award-winning kitten rescuer, humane educator, and New York Times bestselling author who has dedicated her life to innovating kitten care and protecting the most vulnerable felines. Her project, Kitten Lady, provides educational media, training resources, and instructional workshops that help individuals and animal shelters learn how to save the lives of kittens--in a fun and engaging format.

Shaw is the author of Tiny But Mighty, Cats of the World, Kitten Lady’s Big Book of Little Kittens, Kitten Lady’s CATivity Book, the Adventures in Fosterland chapter book series, and Cat Got Your Tongue?

Shaw is also the founder of Orphan Kitten Club, a 501(c)3 charitable organization transforming the landscape of kitten welfare in America through shelter grants, ethical pediatric research, and the hands-on care of vulnerable neonates. Her nonprofit has provided more than $3 million in targeted funding to shelters to build innovative programs that save little lives.
